div.head: Hn com 3.3
div.ab: Et hoc duello fiat, nisi in eis remanserit.
Et hoc duello fiat nisi in eis remanserit.
And the proof shall be by combat, unless they agree to some other mode of proof.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 286–287 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text added from Gesetze I p. 524, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)
